name: Motorpsycho
description:
Motorpsychodelia! Motorpsycho har holdt det gående siden 1989, og er fremdeles like kompromissløse, relevante, dominante – og ubeskrivelig bra. Lørdag 6. mars kommer de til Rockefeller på sin «Taking Trøndelag To The People»-turné!

«In March and April next year, we’re painting our faces and shining our shoes and going out again. As usual, we begin in Norway, before carrying on out into Europe on our Taking Trøndelag To The People Tour, ’27. We will be presenting a whole new stage show featuring new gizmoes and gadgets, as well as jams and tunes never before seen or heard on the Motorpsychodelic stage. We’ll be singing established classic songs as well as classics to be, we’ll reach for the stars and aim for the infinete, but hit your hearts and blow your minds, Trønder Style! Bring ear plugs, wear comfy shoes and get ready to get thoroughly Motorpsychodelisized!»
**– Motorpsycho**

--
